title: Liquid Metal Phase Transitions and Robotic Adhesion
title_zh: 液态金属动态相变与机器人黏附
summary: A Ga–Bi–In–Sn liquid metal system for robotic adhesion through controlled phase transitions.
outcome: Alloy composition screening and DSC characterization support a temperature-controlled demonstration of picking up, holding and placing a cube.

image.alt: Robot arm holding a green cube with the liquid metal adhesion device
image.caption: Experimental robot demonstration using the adhesion device.

title: Liquid Metal Motion and Navigation
summary: A robot-assisted laboratory platform for studying magnetic control of liquid metal droplet motion through transparent channels.
outcome: The project also explores preliminary path planning for liquid metal navigation.

image.alt: Robot-assisted experimental platform with transparent channels for liquid metal motion
image.caption: Experimental setup for liquid metal motion in transparent channels.

title: Horizontal Pendulum TENG for Wave Energy
title_zh: 用于低频波能量收集的水平摆摩擦纳米发电机
summary: A horizontal pendulum triboelectric nanogenerator design and test platform for low-frequency wave energy harvesting.
outcome: The work investigates mechanical motion and frictional contact-area optimization, with metamorphic mechanism concepts.

image.alt: Exploded design concept of a transformable triboelectric nanogenerator module
image.caption: Transformable TENG concept shown alongside the wave-energy project in the presentation.

title: Standing-Assistance Wheelchair
title_zh: 可变换行走方式的助起立轮椅
summary: An assistive wheelchair project with a prototype shown in the presentation and a related design for switchable wheel and crawler mobility and a lifting seat.
role: First-listed co-inventor on the related utility model patent.
outcome: Related utility model CN211835060U granted in 2020.

image.alt: Wheelchair prototype shown in the presentation
image.caption: Wheelchair prototype shown in the presentation.

title: Toilet-Assistance Device with a Lifting Seat
title_zh: 一种具有提升装置的坐便辅助器
summary: A mechanical aid designed to assist sitting and standing during toileting, combining an underarm support linkage with a lifting and tilting seat.
role: Team design contributor and co-inventor, listed second on the utility model patent.

image.alt: CAD model of the toilet-assistance device with a lifting seat and underarm support
image.caption: CAD design of the toilet-assistance device.

title: Automobile Door Checker Mechanism
title_zh: 一种汽车车门限位装置
summary: A mechanical door checker combining a slotted limiting rod, paired locking elements and spring-loaded deceleration components to regulate door opening.
role: Co-inventor, listed fifth on the patent as 全振谭 due to a registration spelling error.
outcome: Chinese utility model CN210888469U, granted 30 June 2020; application 201921497267.0.
